name: Positive Pay
description: An automated check and ACH fraud detection service that matches checks and electronic debits presented for payment against a client-submitted issue file, flagging any mismatches for review before funds move.
ideal_client: Businesses that issue a moderate-to-high volume of checks, have experienced or fear check/ACH fraud, or operate with multiple signers and locations.
benefits: Drastically reduces check and ACH fraud losses
Gives finance teams a daily exception review workflow instead of after-the-fact loss discovery
Strengthens internal controls for audit and compliance
Protects company reputation and banking relationships
requirements: Ability to submit a daily issue file (check register) to the bank
Designated staff to review and decision daily exception items
Online banking access for exception management

name: ACH Origination
description: Enables a business to originate electronic ACH credits and debits directly from its own systems, including payroll, vendor payments, and customer collections, eliminating paper checks.
ideal_client: Companies with recurring payroll, vendor payments, or customer billing that currently rely heavily on paper checks or manual payment processes.
benefits: Reduces check printing, postage, and reconciliation costs
Speeds up payroll and vendor payment cycles
Improves cash flow predictability
Integrates with most ERP and payroll systems
requirements: ACH origination agreement and underwriting approval
ERP or payroll system capable of generating NACHA files, or use of the bank's origination portal
Established payment approval / dual-control workflow

name: Lockbox
description: A dedicated bank-operated P.O. box and processing service that receives, opens, scans, and deposits customer checks and remittances on the client's behalf, same-day.
ideal_client: Businesses that receive a high volume of mailed customer payments and need to accelerate collections and reduce internal processing labor.
benefits: Accelerates funds availability by processing remittances same-day
Reduces internal mailroom and deposit-prep labor
Provides detailed remittance data for faster AR posting
Improves segregation of duties for audit purposes
requirements: Customer-facing remittance address change to the lockbox P.O. box
AR system capable of importing lockbox remittance files (BAI2/CSV)

name: Remote Deposit Capture
description: Allows staff to scan and deposit checks electronically from any office location using a desktop scanner or mobile app, without a trip to the branch.
ideal_client: Multi-location businesses or any company that regularly receives in-person or mailed checks away from a branch.
benefits: Eliminates branch trips and deposit delays across locations
Accelerates funds availability
Centralizes deposit reporting across all locations
Reduces courier and armored transport costs
requirements: Check scanner (desktop or mobile-capable) at each depositing location
Secure internet connection and online banking enrollment

name: Cash Vault
description: Secure armored-carrier cash and coin deposit processing for businesses with heavy daily currency volume, with provisional same-day credit and detailed deposit verification reporting.
ideal_client: Cash-intensive businesses such as retail, restaurants, and grocery with significant daily currency deposits across one or more locations.
benefits: Reduces in-branch teller time and staff safety risk from cash handling
Provides provisional same-day ledger credit for deposited cash
Detailed variance reporting between counted and verified deposits
Scales cleanly across multiple locations
requirements: Sufficient daily/weekly cash volume to justify armored carrier costs
Coordination with an approved armored transport vendor

name: Zero Balance Accounts (ZBA)
description: A structure of subsidiary or departmental accounts that automatically sweep to zero at the end of each day, concentrating all funds into a single master account for centralized control.
ideal_client: Businesses with multiple entities, departments, or locations that want centralized cash visibility and control without manual inter-account transfers.
benefits: Eliminates idle balances scattered across subsidiary accounts
Simplifies daily cash positioning and reduces manual transfers
Maintains distinct accounting for each entity/department while centralizing funds
Improves interest earnings and borrowing efficiency on the master account
requirements: Master operating account plus one or more subsidiary accounts at the bank
Defined account structure aligned to entities, departments, or locations

name: Sweep Accounts
description: Automatically transfers excess operating balances above a target threshold into an interest-bearing investment or line-of-credit paydown vehicle overnight, then sweeps back the next business day.
ideal_client: Businesses holding excess idle cash in operating accounts, or those wanting to minimize revolving line-of-credit interest expense automatically.
benefits: Maximizes yield on idle operating cash without manual intervention
Can automatically pay down a line of credit to reduce interest expense
Maintains full liquidity for next-day operating needs
Removes manual, error-prone end-of-day cash decisions
requirements: Operating account with the bank and a defined target/peg balance
Investment sweep vehicle or line of credit to sweep against

name: Merchant Services
description: Card payment acceptance solutions spanning in-person terminals, e-commerce gateways, and mobile card readers, with next-day funding and integrated reporting.
ideal_client: Businesses that accept or want to accept debit/credit card payments in-store, online, or on the go, especially those growing sales channels.
benefits: Expands accepted payment methods to grow sales
Next-day funding improves cash flow
Integrated reporting simplifies reconciliation
PCI-compliant processing reduces card data risk
requirements: Merchant underwriting approval
POS hardware or e-commerce gateway integration
PCI-DSS compliance attestation

name: Wire Transfers
description: Domestic and international same-day wire origination for large-dollar or time-critical payments, with dual-approval controls and same-day settlement.
ideal_client: Businesses that make large, time-sensitive, or international payments such as supplier settlements, real estate closings, or payroll to international contractors.
benefits: Same-day, irrevocable settlement for time-critical payments
Supports both domestic and international currency transfers
Dual-control approval workflow reduces fraud risk
Templates and repetitive wires speed up recurring payments
requirements: Wire agreement with dual-approval setup
Online banking or treasury workstation access

name: Controlled Disbursement
description: Provides early-morning notification of the day's total check clearings against a disbursement account, giving treasury staff precise, same-day funding requirements before the account must be funded.
ideal_client: Businesses that issue a high dollar volume of checks and want precise daily cash-funding visibility rather than over-funding disbursement accounts as a buffer.
benefits: Improves forecasting accuracy for daily disbursement funding
Frees up cash that would otherwise sit idle as a funding buffer
Pairs naturally with sweep or ZBA structures for full liquidity optimization
Reduces overdraft risk through early notification
requirements: Dedicated disbursement account
Treasury staff available to review the early-morning funding notification and fund the account same day

name: Business Bill Pay
description: An online platform for scheduling and paying vendor bills electronically (ACH, check, or virtual card) from a single dashboard, with approval workflows and payment history.
ideal_client: Small-to-mid-sized businesses with manual, check-based accounts-payable processes and limited AP staff.
benefits: Consolidates all vendor payments into a single online workflow
Reduces manual check writing and mailing
Provides approval routing for internal controls
Centralized payment history simplifies reconciliation and audit
requirements: Online banking enrollment
Vendor payment details (W-9/banking info) for electronic payment setup

name: Information Reporting
description: A consolidated online treasury workstation providing real-time and prior-day balance and transaction reporting across all accounts, with BAI2/CSV data feeds for ERP integration.
ideal_client: Businesses with multiple accounts, entities, or locations that need centralized visibility into cash positions, or that want to automate cash reconciliation into their ERP.
benefits: Single view of balances and transactions across every account and entity
Automates daily cash positioning and forecasting
BAI2/CSV feeds integrate directly into most ERP systems
Improves internal controls through consolidated audit trails
requirements: Online banking / treasury workstation enrollment for all applicable accounts
ERP capable of ingesting BAI2 or CSV feeds for full integration value
